eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Siskiyou, CA; at 12:53 PM on AUG 29, 2025 Effective until 8:53 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Siskiyou County Sheriffs Office has issued an EVACUATION ORDER for Zone 1509-A in the area of Sandy Bar Creek due to the Dillon Fire. Anyone in this area is ordered to leave now. 
Note: The previous Zone 1509-A has been split into a northern half (Zone 1509-A), and a southern half (1509-C)
